gold_points: BCOP default may cross-default the BCOP Credit Agreement, letting lenders accelerate maturity of outstanding balances
Secured swap counterparties can terminate hedges and require settlement if BCOP debt is accelerated
Nuveen UPA cross default triggered by acceleration of debt exceeding greater of 1.5% of total assets and $600 million
Nuveen UPA default makes Vistra Vision Holdings' and guarantors' payment obligations immediately due and payable
output.note: Single passage covers cross-default provisions clearly; trailing headings are just section titles.
output.question: In Vistra Corp.'s fiscal 2024 10-K, what are the consequences of a default under the BCOP Credit Agreement and the Nuveen UPA, including effects on the related interest rate swap agreements?
